doctrine.sample_age: Independent health signal. Not a host-gate reject. Eventual device candidate must be STABLE on both fixtures.

silence.non_zero_tempo_assertions: locked/beat_tick/prism-spawn/full-confidence-gate; bpm field may retain last winner and is not itself an assertion
silence.lock_release: no slower than spread after silence onset

settled.octave_family: correct fixture BPM (1 BPM quantised bin)
settled.beat_timing_oracle: analytical AP clicks mapped onto the peak-held novelty emit (frames 3,6,9,...). The flywheel can only tick on emit frames; raw AP-click times would confuse decimation with tracker error. Spread is not the oracle.

dropouts: no worse than spread on false unlock, coast, beat count, BPM recovery, phase recovery

goertzel_exact_subgate.identity: For the same novelty history, k1_tempi[*].magnitude_raw under rolling ACF + shared window must match spread + k1_compute_magnitude (bit-identical, -ffp-contract=off).

feasibility_stop.rule: Combined candidate earns B489 only if operation-count evidence makes >=1.8 ms S3 saving plausible. If exact Goertzel can only plausibly save 100-200 us and rolling ACF cannot close the rest, HOLD the flash.

map_territory: Host novelty trains are not MEMS+GDFT novelty. Passing this gate does not prove Anchor Point lock.
APCAD active_us is CPU demand, not acoustic-to-light latency.
Spread ACF encodes sweep staleness. Disagreeing with spread is not automatically incorrect.
Shared-window Goertzel is an exactness claim and is tested as such, separately from ACF freshness.
